verdict.rationale: Paddle has an API reference and supports interactive exploration, but only through external tools. Its Postman collection "includes every operation, so you can try the API interactively before writing code," and the OpenAPI 3.1 spec can be loaded into Scalar, Redocly or Stoplight. A separate Sandbox environment lets those calls run safely. The evidence never shows the hosted API reference itself offering an in-page try-it console or runnable code examples, so the interactive part depends on third-party tools. Missing for 10: a built-in interactive try-it console in the docs API reference, runnable per-endpoint code examples, and hands-on corroboration that the interactive experience works.
